reason: The pet and the streak thing honestly hook me, and I'd mess around with the free demo money on my commute. But putting my real money behind an AI, through a broker you haven't even named, at a price you haven't set? I'm not signing up for that yet.
objection: I don't trust an AI with my money. A cute pet and a kill switch don't tell me who actually holds my account or who pays if the agent makes a dumb trade.
would_change_my_mind: Months of the demo agent doing sensible things with my demo portfolio, plus a named, licensed broker that I recognize holding the real money.
